'''Yorsh Manted''' was an [[Agents of the Mining Guild|employee]] of the [[Mining Guild]] who was sent to patrol the criminal [[Pyke Syndicate]]'s [[Spice mines of Kessel|spice mines]] on the [[planet]] [[Kessel]] in order to make sure the guild got its cut of the profits. In [[10 BBY]], Manted checked a pair of [[Slavery|slaves]] being given to the Pyke [[capo]] [[Quay Tolsite]] shortly before the slaves working the mine [[Raid on Kessel|revolted]] and overthrew the Pyke overseers.

==Biography==
During the [[Imperial Era|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire]], Yorsh Manted worked for the [[Mining Guild]] and [[Agents of the Mining Guild|represented]] its interests in the criminal [[Pyke Syndicate]]'s [[Spice mines of Kessel|spice mines]] on the [[planet]] [[Kessel]] by patrolling and ensuring the guild got its cut. The [[Pyke]]s agreed to Manted and the other guild employees being there, but often disagreed with them on tactics for running the mine, as the criminals preferred less bureaucratic and more brutal methods of security.<ref name="SoloOG" /> In [[10 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story The Official Guide]]'' dates the events on [[Kessel]] in ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]'' to nine years after the [[Proclamation of the New Order|formation]] of the [[Galactic Empire]]. ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' dates the formation of the Empire to [[19 BBY]], therefore the event on Kessel in ''Solo'' must take place in [[10 BBY]].</ref> Manted and another guild employee accompanied the Pyke [[capo]] [[Quay Tolsite]] when he traveled to one of the mine's landing pads to meet the crew of the [[YT-1300 light freighter]] known as the ''[[Millennium Falcon]]''.<ref name="Solo">''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]''</ref>

[[File:Tolsite-at-Kessel.jpg|thumb|left|Yorsh Manted worked on Kessel.|200px]]
The crew was led by the [[human]] [[Qi'ra]] who claimed to be a [[Slavery|slaver]] and offered her captives [[Han Solo]] and [[Chewbacca]] as a sample of her product. Manted and the other guild employee checked the two slaves and upon signaling that they were satisfied, Tolsite had Solo and Chewbacca taken away while he took Qi'ra to discuss business. However, the ''Falcon's'' crew were actually on Kessel to steal the Pyke's [[coaxium]] and started a [[Raid on Kessel|slave revolt]] in which the miners overthrew their Pyke overseers.<ref name="Solo" />

==Equipment==
Manted wore [[Color|white]] [[Clothing|coveralls]] along with white [[glove]]s, a brown [[bandolier]], and a white helmet that included a datafeed headset and [[goggles]]. The coveralls were marked with red sigils denoting one of the houses of the Mining Guild.<ref name="SoloOG" />

==Behind the scenes==
Yorsh Manted first appeared in the [[2018]] film ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]''<ref name="Solo" /> and was first named in the accompanying reference book ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story The Official Guide]]'', which was written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]].<ref name="SoloOG" />
